name: Mountain Home AFB
description: Home of the 366th Fighter Wing. Mountain Home AFB trains and projects multi-role fighter capabilities with F-15E Strike Eagles and supports the Air Force Combat Rescue Officer training pipeline.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Grand View Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access point. Located off Grand View Highway. Main entry for routine access.
gates.address: Grand View Gate, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Visitor Control Center at Bldg 5400 remains open for pass processing. Main Gate entry point is closed.
gates.address: Main Gate, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5400)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; after hours passes at Grand View Gate
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Located at 366 Gunfighter Ave. Gunfighter Pass program available for local civilians.
gates.address: 366 Gunfighter Ave, Bldg 5400, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

resources.name: Wagon Wheel Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC with 21-day menu, grab-n-go options, grill, deli, fresh vegetables, breads, and meats. ESM (Essential Station Messing) for dorm residents.
resources.hours: See posted meal hours; midnight meals available
resources.address: 480 7th Avenue, Bldg 2316, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

resources.name: Mountain Home Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Idaho Central Credit Union / Local CU Branch
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, aquatics, and sports amenities.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments. UH at 530 Phantom Avenue.
resources.address: 530 Phantom Avenue, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

resources.name: Sagebrush Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF with kitchenettes, laundry, and playground access. Pet-friendly rooms available (limited).
resources.address: 875 Falcon Street, Bldg 2320, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 366th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, Trap & Skeet Range, Gunsmoke Range, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Silver Sage Golf & Event Center
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop, Hackers Grill, and event facilities.
resources.address: 435 1st Ave, Bldg 195, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

resources.name: Strikers Bowling Center / Gunfighter Greens
resources.description: Bowling alley with mini golf and recreational activities.
resources.address: 680 Falcon St, Bldg 2805, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

resources.name: 366th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5400)
primaryAction.address: 366 Gunfighter Ave, Bldg 5400, Mountain Home AFB, ID 83648

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Sagebrush Inn (208-828-5200) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (208-828-1401) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 366 FSS, M&FRC, and official Mountain Home sites for in-processing and fighter mission support.
